sentences.text: Gemma Shaw is the mother of Noah and Isla.
Noah is four months old and has a scheduled four-month check-up.
Noah weighs 6.8 kilos, which is on his growth line.
Isla is in reception at school and her teacher is Miss Patel.
Isla is reading little words at school.
Ryan is Liam's brother and babysits on Fridays when the mother is at work and Liam is on night shifts.
Ryan has been babysitting since September.
Noah is currently on formula, consuming five ounces every three to four hours.
Noah has six to seven wet nappies per day.
Noah sleeps in a Moses basket in the mother's room.
Noah's sleep pattern is a five-hour stretch from about 11 p.m. to 4 a.m.
The mother has not asked Isla any further questions about the incident.
The mother has written down what Isla said, in her own words, with the date.
The mother has not asked Isla to repeat or elaborate on the incident.
Isla told her mother that Uncle Ryan touched her private parts, which she calls 'her front bottom', when he babysits.
Isla said the incident happened on Sunday night while she was in the bath.
Isla said Ryan told her it was a secret and not to tell mummy.
The health visitor, Rachel Moore, will share the information about Isla's disclosure with children's social care (Harbridge MASH) due to concerns for child safety.
The health visitor will share the disclosure with Harbridge MASH, the children's social care service.
The mother, Gemma, has not told the father Liam about Isla's disclosure, but has told him about it.
Liam does not believe Isla's statement but is emotionally distressed.
The mother's sister, Kelly, said that Ryan was in trouble with the police years ago, but does not know what it was.
Kelly heard about Ryan's past incident from someone at her work and does not know if it is true.
The health visitor advised the mother not to confront Ryan directly or question Isla before a police investigation.
The health visitor advised the mother to ensure Ryan does not have any time alone with Isla or Noah until the matter is investigated.
The mother has agreed to prevent Ryan from having any contact with Isla or Noah until further notice.
The mother has agreed to ask Liam to wait before visiting Ryan's home.
The mother has suggested that her mother could look after the children on Fridays instead of Ryan.
The mother has suggested swapping her shift at the Co-op to free up time for childcare on Fridays.
The mother earns income from working at the Co-op and receives child benefit.
